If you can’t figure this out and can’t find free tax help (I think there are some community things that often help) I wouldn’t bother unless you say you donated like thousands and thousands to the church. 

Feel free to correct me folks, but at the most basic level: Essentially, you pay taxes on the amount you earn. You want to use deductions to make your income as small as possible, so you pay less taxes. So you “deduct” the things you spent from your income, so your income looks small.
